text: The symbol-grounding problem (Harnad) and the 'stochastic parrots' critique (Bender, Gebru, et al., 2021) both press which objection to attributing understanding to a text-manipulating AI?
choices: The system's symbols are not grounded in its own perceptual and causal relationship to the world, so it inherits meaning only from human-produced text
The system violates Goedel's incompleteness theorem
The system cannot store enough canned responses to win a table-lookup test
The system is feedforward and therefore has zero integrated information
explanation: Both arguments hold that genuine meaning requires grounding in the representer's own connection to the world; an LLM's tokens are 'about' things only derivatively, via the humans who wrote its training text. Goedel is Turing's mathematical objection, table-lookup is Block's Blockhead, and feedforward Phi is IIT, all distinct points.
